task_instance: Set up a Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint and a client that consumes it: generate a production-shaped SSE server that streams events over the text/event-stream content type (with id/event/data fields and a terminating event) plus a client that parses the SSE wire format, then run them locally and verify the stream is received and parsed correctly.
evidence: Created sse_server.py (ThreadingHTTPServer serving GET /events with Content-Type text/event-stream, Cache-Control no-cache, streaming 5 named 'tick' events carrying id/event/data fields plus a final 'done' event) and sse_client.py (stdlib urllib client with proxy disabled via empty ProxyHandler since 127.0.0.1 is loopback; reads the stream line-by-line, parses the SSE wire format, and asserts the results). Ran: started the server on loopback 127.0.0.1:8077, slept 1s, ran the client. Client output showed content-type: text/event-stream, num_events: 6, the five tick events with ids 1-5 and JSON data payloads, the done event, and 'RESULT: PASS - SSE stream received, parsed, and verified' with client_exit=0. The deliverable (working SSE setup, server and client) exists and was verified end-to-end entirely on the local machine with no network, no installs, and stdlib only. The SKILL.md is a generic auto-activating API-integration skill with no bundled scripts or reference files to run, so no skill files were missing.
